============================================================================\n50\t\n51\tstruct Vec3 {\n52\t    val_t x, y, z;\n53\t\n54\t    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}\n55\t    constexpr const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }\n62\t    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }\n63\t\n64\t    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }\n65\t    Vec3 ============================================================================\n104\t\n105\t// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\n106\tbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n107\t    // Translate triangle to box center\n108\t    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n109\t    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n110\t    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n111\t\n112\t    // Triangle edges\n113\t    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n114\t    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n115\t    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n116\t\n117\t    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n118\t    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n119\t        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n120\t    };\n121\t\n122\t    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n123\t    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n124\t\n125\t    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n126\t    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n127\t\n128\t    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n129\t    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n130\t\n131\t    // Test triangle normal\n132\t    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n133\t    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n134\t    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n135\t              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n136\t              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n137\t    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n138\t\n139\t    // Test 9 edge cross products\n140\t    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n141\t        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n142\t        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n143\t        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n144\t        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n145\t                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n146\t                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n147\t        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n148\t        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n149\t    };\n150\t\n151\t    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n152\t    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n153\t    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n154\t        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n155\t            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n156\t            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n157\t                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n158\t            }\n159\t        }\n160\t    }\n161\t\n162\t    return true;\n163\t}\n164\t\n165\t// ============================================================================\n166\t// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n167\t// ============================================================================\n168\t\n169\tconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\n170\tconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n171\t\n172\tclass Octree {\n173\tpublic:\n174\t    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n175\t    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n176\t    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n177\t    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n178\t    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n179\t\n180\t    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t        // Compute bounding box\n187\t        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n188\t        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n189\t        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n190\t            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n194\t                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n195\t                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n196\t                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197\t            }\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        // Collect all indices\n201\t        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203\t\n204\t        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205\t    }\n206\t\n207\tprivate:\n208\t    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209\t        minBound = nodeMin;\n210\t        maxBound = nodeMax;\n211\t        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212\t        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n566\t        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n567\t    }\n568\t\n569\t    // Initialize reflectivity\n570\t    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = ============================================================================\n\nHOST_DEVICE val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                       const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Device view of the scene geometry and acceleration structure\nstruct SceneView {\n    const Triangle* tris;\n    const OctreeNode* nodes;\n    const uint32_t* triList;\n};\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle.\n// Walks the octree like the original recursive search: the root is always entered,\n// children are entered only when their box is hit, and leaves are tested per triangle.\nHOST_DEVICE bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const SceneView& scene,\n                              size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    uint32_t stack[TRAVERSAL_STACK_SIZE];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const OctreeNode& node = scene.nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (node.triCount > 0) {\n            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triCount; ++k) {\n                size_t idx = scene.triList[node.triBegin + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n\n                const Triangle& tri = scene.tris[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n                    return true;  // Ray is blocked\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int32_t child = node.children[c];\n                if (child >= 0 && rayIntersectsBox(scene.nodes[child].center,\n                                                   scene.nodes[child].halfExtent, from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = static_cast<uint32_t>(child);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nHOST_DEVICE val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return maxVal(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Triangles facing the same direction exchange no energy\nHOST_DEVICE bool isCulled(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    return triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f;\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter).\n// Ray r consumes words[4r..4r+3]: u and v for the point on triI, then u and v for the point on triJ.\nHOST_DEVICE val_t computeKij(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ, const uint32_t* words,\n                             const SceneView& scene, size_t idxI, size_t idxJ) {\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        const uint32_t* w = words + 4 * r;\n        Vec3 pI = pointInTriangle(triI, uniformFromWord(w[0]), uniformFromWord(w[1]));\n        Vec3 pJ = pointInTriangle(triJ, uniformFromWord(w[2]), uniformFromWord(w[3]));\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, scene, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nHOST_DEVICE int computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source (host copy)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N, row-major); host copy, validation only\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N); host copy, validation only\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // Device-resident data\n    DevBuf<Triangle> d_triangles;\n    DevBuf<OctreeNode> d_nodes;\n    DevBuf<uint32_t> d_triList;\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_areas;          // Area of each triangle\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_rho;            // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_kij;            // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    DevBuf<int> d_tau;              // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_radE;           // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_radB;           // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_distances;      // Distances from source\n\n    SceneView scene() const { return {d_triangles.get(), d_nodes.get(), d_triList.get()}; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", N);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    Octree octree;\n    octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    std::vector<OctreeNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<uint32_t> triList;\n    int levels = flattenOctree(octree, nodes, triList);\n    // Worst-case DFS stack depth for the traversal is 7 * levels + 1\n    if (7 * levels + 1 > TRAVERSAL_STACK_SIZE) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree depth %d exceeds traversal stack capacity\\n\", levels);\n        exit(1);\n    }\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    std::vector<val_t> areas(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    std::vector<val_t> rho(N, reflectivity);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        radE[t * N + state.sourceIndex] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // Upload to device\n    state.d_triangles = uploadToDevice(state.triangles);\n    state.d_nodes = uploadToDevice(nodes);\n    state.d_triList = uploadToDevice(triList);\n    state.d_areas = uploadToDevice(areas);\n    state.d_rho = uploadToDevice(rho);\n    state.d_radE = uploadToDevice(radE);\n    state.d_radB = uploadToDevice(std::vector<val_t>(timesteps * N, ZERO));\n    state.d_kij = allocDevice<val_t>(N * N);\n    state.d_tau = allocDevice<int>(N * N);\n    state.d_distances = allocDevice<val_t>(N);\n    state.distances.assign(N, ZERO);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(size_t N, const Triangle* tris, int* tau) {\n    size_t idx = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (idx >= N * N) return;\n\n    size_t i = idx / N;\n    size_t j = idx % N;\n    tau[idx] = (i == j) ? 0 : computeTau(tris[i], tris[j]);\n}\n\n// Inclusive prefix sum across one warp\n__device__ uint32_t warpInclusiveScan(uint32_t value) {\n    const uint32_t lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    for (uint32_t d = 1; d < 32; d <<= 1) {\n        uint32_t up = __shfl_up_sync(0xffffffffu, value, d);\n        if (lane >= d) value += up;\n    }\n    return value;\n}\n\n// Block-wide exclusive prefix sum of one value per thread (blockDim.x == BLOCK_SIZE).\n// Returns this thread's exclusive prefix; every thread receives the block total.\n__device__ uint32_t blockExclusiveScan(uint32_t value, uint32_t& total, uint32_t* warpSums) {\n    const uint32_t lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const uint32_t warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n\n    uint32_t inclusive = warpInclusiveScan(value);\n    if (lane == 31) warpSums[warp] = inclusive;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    if (warp == 0) {\n        uint32_t s = lane < NUM_WARPS ? warpSums[lane] : 0;\n        s = warpInclusiveScan(s);\n        if (lane < NUM_WARPS) warpSums[lane] = s;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    total = warpSums[NUM_WARPS - 1];\n    const uint32_t warpOffset = warp > 0 ? warpSums[warp - 1] : 0;\n    return inclusive - value + warpOffset;\n}\n\n// Counts, per receiver row, the pairs that consume random words (i != j and not culled)\n__global__ void countFormFactorPairsKernel(size_t N, const Triangle* tris, uint32_t* counts) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t partial[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;\n    const Triangle triI = tris[i];\n\n    uint32_t count = 0;\n    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < N; j += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        if (j != i && !isCulled(triI, tris[j])) ++count;\n    }\n\n    partial[threadIdx.x] = count;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (unsigned s = BLOCK_SIZE / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < s) partial[threadIdx.x] += partial[threadIdx.x + s];\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) counts[i] = partial[0];\n}\n\n// One block per receiver row (rows rowBegin .. rowBegin + gridDim.x - 1). Column tiles are\n// scanned in ascending j, so each consuming pair gets the exact word offset it would have\n// in the sequential original, where the random stream advanced once per consuming pair.\n__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(size_t N, size_t rowBegin, SceneView scene,\n                                         const uint64_t* rowPrefix, const uint32_t* words,\n                                         val_t* kij) {\n    __shared__ uint32_t warpSums[NUM_WARPS];\n\n    const size_t i = rowBegin + blockIdx.x;\n    const Triangle triI = scene.tris[i];\n\n    // Consuming pairs in this chunk that precede row i, plus those earlier in this row\n    const uint32_t rowFirstPair = static_cast<uint32_t>(rowPrefix[i] - rowPrefix[rowBegin]);\n    uint32_t pairsSoFar = 0;\n\n    for (size_t tile = 0; tile < N; tile += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        const size_t j = tile + threadIdx.x;\n        const bool valid = j < N;\n        const bool consumes = valid && j != i && !isCulled(triI, scene.tris[j]);\n\n        uint32_t tileTotal;\n        const uint32_t excl = blockExclusiveScan(consumes ? 1u : 0u, tileTotal, warpSums);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            val_t value = ZERO;\n            if (consumes) {\n                const size_t pair = rowFirstPair + pairsSoFar + excl;\n                value = computeKij(triI, scene.tris[j], words + pair * WORDS_PER_PAIR,\n                                   scene, i, j);\n            }\n            kij[i * N + j] = value;\n        }\n\n        pairsSoFar += tileTotal;\n        __syncthreads();  // warpSums is reused by the next tile\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>((N * N + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);\n    computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(N, state.d_triangles.get(), state.d_tau.get());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const SceneView scene = state.scene();\n\n    // Consuming pair counts per row, and their prefix sums\n    DevBuf<uint32_t> d_counts = allocDevice<uint32_t>(N);\n    countFormFactorPairsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(N), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(N, scene.tris, d_counts.get());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    std::vector<uint32_t> counts(N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(counts.data(), d_counts.get(), N * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowPrefix(N + 1, 0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        rowPrefix[i + 1] = rowPrefix[i] + counts[i];\n    }\n    DevBuf<uint64_t> d_rowPrefix = uploadToDevice(rowPrefix);\n\n    // Split rows into chunks whose random words fit in one staging buffer\n    struct RowRange {\n        size_t begin, end;\n    };\n    std::vector<RowRange> chunks;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < N;) {\n        size_t end = r + 1;\n        while (end < N && (rowPrefix[end + 1] - rowPrefix[r]) * WORDS_PER_PAIR <= CHUNK_WORDS) {\n            ++end;\n        }\n        chunks.push_back({r, end});\n        r = end;\n    }\n\n    // Random words are generated in the same order as the sequential original (seed 42)\n    std::mt19937 engine(42);\n    auto fillChunk = [&](const RowRange& range, uint32_t* dst) -> size_t {\n        const size_t words = (rowPrefix[range.end] - rowPrefix[range.begin]) * WORDS_PER_PAIR;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < words; ++k) {\n            dst[k] = static_cast<uint32_t>(engine());\n        }\n        return words;\n    };\n\n    // Double-buffered pipeline: the host fills one staging buffer while the device consumes the other\n    DevBuf<uint32_t> d_words = allocDevice<uint32_t>(CHUNK_WORDS);\n    PinnedWordBuf h_words[2];\n    cudaEvent_t copied[2];\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        uint32_t* ptr = nullptr;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&ptr, CHUNK_WORDS * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n        h_words[b].reset(ptr);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&copied[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    }\n\n    std::vector<size_t> chunkWords(chunks.size());\n    chunkWords[0] = fillChunk(chunks[0], h_words[0].get());\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < chunks.size(); ++c) {\n        const int b = static_cast<int>(c & 1);\n        const RowRange& range = chunks[c];\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(d_words.get(), h_words[b].get(), chunkWords[c] * sizeof(uint32_t),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, 0));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(copied[b], 0));\n\n        computeFormFactorsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(range.end - range.begin), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(\n            N, range.begin, scene, d_rowPrefix.get(), d_words.get(), state.d_kij.get());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if (c + 1 < chunks.size()) {\n            const int nb = static_cast<int>((c + 1) & 1);\n            // The staging buffer for the next chunk was last read by the copy issued two chunks back\n            if (c >= 1) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(copied[nb]));\n            chunkWords[c + 1] = fillChunk(chunks[c + 1], h_words[nb].get());\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(copied[b]));\n    }\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == N) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, N);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Advances the simulation by one timestep. Each thread owns receiver i and sums over j in\n// the original order. tau >= 1 for distinct triangles, so every radB read targets an earlier\n// timestep, and all receivers of timestep t can be computed concurrently.\n__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(size_t N, size_t t, const int* tau, const val_t* kij,\n                                       const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho, const val_t* radE,\n                                       val_t* radB) {\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tau[i * N + j];\n\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n        val_t kijVal = kij[i * N + j];\n        if (kijVal <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n        size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n        val_t radJ = radB[srcTime * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n        sumB += minVal(kijVal * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n    radB[t * N + i] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[t * N + i];\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>((N + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        simulateTimestepKernel<<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(\n            N, t, state.d_tau.get(), state.d_kij.get(), state.d_areas.get(),\n            state.d_rho.get(), state.d_radE.get(), state.d_radB.get());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(size_t N, size_t T, size_t sourceIndex, const val_t* radB,\n                                       val_t* distances) {\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n\n    // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n        for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[tt * N + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[(tt - t) * N + sourceIndex];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>((N + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);\n    computeDistancesKernel<<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(N, state.numTimesteps, state.sourceIndex,\n                                                   state.d_radB.get(), state.d_distances.get());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    // Synchronizing copy: marks the end of the phase\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.d_distances.get(), N * sizeof(val_t),\n                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// Copies the large intermediate results back to the host for validation only\nvoid downloadForValidation(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    state.kij.resize(N * N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.d_kij.get(), N * N * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    state.radB.resize(T * N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.d_radB.get(), T * N * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[t * state.numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n a raw 32-bit Mersenne Twister word to [0, 1) exactly as libstdc++'s\n// std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0, 1) does for std::mt19937\nHOST_DEVICE inline val_t uniformFromWord(uint32_t word) {\n v)\nHOST_DEVICE Vec3 pointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nHOST_DEVICE val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                       const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Device view of the scene geometry and acceleration structure\nstruct SceneView {\n    const Triangle* tris;\n    const OctreeNode* nodes;\n    const uint32_t* triList;\n};\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle.\n// Walks the octree like the original recursive search: the root is always entered,\n// children are entered only when their box is hit, and leaves are tested per triangle.\nHOST_DEVICE bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const SceneView& scene,\n                              size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    uint32_t stack[TRAVERSAL_STACK_SIZE];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const OctreeNode& node = scene.nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (node.triCount > 0) {\n            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triCount; ++k) {\n                size_t idx = scene.triList[node.triBegin + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n                    return true;  // Ray is blocked\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int32_t child = node.children[c];\n                if (child >= 0 && rayIntersectsBox(scene.nodes[child].center,\n                                                   scene.nodes[child].halfExtent, from, to)) {\n ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// return maxVal(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Triangles facing the same direction exchange no energy\nHOST_DEVICE bool isCulled(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    return size_t idxJ) {\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        const uint32_t* w = words + 4 * r;\n        Vec3 pI = pointInTriangle(triI, uniformFromWord(w[0]), - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N); host copy, validation only\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // Device-resident data\n    DevBuf<Triangle> d_triangles;\n    DevBuf<OctreeNode> d_nodes;\n    DevBuf<uint32_t> d_triList;\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_areas;          // Area of each triangle\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_rho;            // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_kij;            // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    DevBuf<int> d_tau;              // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    DevBuf<val_t> d_radE;           // Emission with %zu triangles\\n\", N);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    Octree octree;\n    octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n const uint32_t lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const uint32_t warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n\n    uint32_t inclusive = warpInclusiveScan(value);\n    if (lane == 31) warpSums[warp] = inclusive;\n  // warpSums is reused by the next tile\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>((N * N + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);\n    computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(N, state.d_triangles.get(), state.d_tau.get());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const SceneView scene = state.scene();\n\n    // Consuming pair counts per row, and their prefix sums\n    DevBuf<uint32_t> d_counts = allocDevice<uint32_t>(N);\n    countFormFactorPairsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(N), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(N, scene.tris, d_counts.get());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    std::vector<uint32_t> counts(N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(counts.data(), d_counts.get(), N * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    std::vector<uint64_t> rowPrefix(N + 1, 0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n}\n\n// validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfxS7ChNSBY3639XzUP1z","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The roomsim benchmark now runs its form factors, wave propagation, and distance phases on the GPU, and its output is identical to the original. I checked the 320, 1280, and 5120 triangle runs and ten edge-case configurations, comparing the result hash and the full results block.\n\n| Triangles | Precomputation (original → CUDA) | Simulation | Result hash |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 320 (default) | 1463 ms → sub-ms to a few ms of GPU work | 14 ms → 4 ms | `73869AC4B37EDF00` |\n| 1280 | 26,300 ms → 499 ms | 190 ms → 20 ms | `D37095BFFEA9A000` |\n| 5120 | 465,906 ms → 4,747 ms | 2,939 ms → 72 ms | `FC804BE22E10F000` |\n\nThe 5120 original reference ran on the same machine but I did not isolate it, so the speedup figures are approximate.\n\n**What changed**\n- `roomsim/roomsim.cpp`: CUDA kernels replace the sequential loops. Form factors use one block per receiver row, with a block-wide scan that gives each pair its exact position in the random stream. Wave propagation and distances use one thread per receiver. The octree is built on the host and walked on the GPU.\n- `roomsim/CMakeLists.txt`: enables the CUDA language, compiles `roomsim.cpp` as CUDA, and sets `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` to `native` by default (overridable). Minimum CMake is now 3.24, which `native` requires. The executable name is unchanged, and no files were added.\n\n**Choices I made**\n- The random stream is still `std::mt19937(42)`, generated on the host in chunks and double-buffered through pinned memory so host generation overlaps GPU work. The GPU converts each word to a float with the same formula libstdc++ uses. This is what keeps results bit-identical.\n- Summation order is preserved in the simulation and distance reductions, so there is no reordering of floating-point sums.\n- `-Wpedantic` is dropped for the CUDA target. nvcc's generated `#line` directives trigger it in every file, producing 870+ warnings. The clean build has zero warnings.\n\n**Limit to be aware of:** the sequential MT19937 stream is now the bottleneck at large sizes. Removing it would mean switching to a counter-based GPU RNG, which parallelizes fully but changes the random samples and therefore the output hash.
